title: solidago bigelovii var. wrightii
intro: Solidago bigelovii var. wrightii, commonly known as Wright's goldenrod, is a plant species in the aster family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Wright's goldenrod include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Wright's goldenrod include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
